summary: Changes the IANA registration policy for Pool 3 of the Differentiated Services codepoint registry. Diffserv uses the DS field in IPv4 and IPv6 headers to carry one of 64 codepoint values, and this update to RFC 2474 changes how Pool 3 values may be assigned.

eli5.summary: Packets carry a tiny label saying how important they are, and there are 64 possible labels. This changes the rule for who may hand out one group of those labels.
